Name: asunai's BFAV Slimes for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from asunai, I've updated their BFAV Slimes (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14299]here[/url]) to SDV 1.6!

Slimes come in 3 main categories: Slime, Cat Slime, and Gradiant Cat Slime. They'll live in your barns. The regular slimes will produce slime drops, while the cat slimes will produce slime poop. All slimes as a deluxe item will produce Slime Essence. All products are sellable and edible. ﻿

Enjoy!
